description: The full approved release scope of the rehearsal: every P0 requirement of the frozen plan and every requirement of the ratified catalog, each with its obligations, evidence producers, implementation work items and dependencies. A passing catalog is not this scope. Generated by `requirements-compiler scope compile`; `scope preflight` refuses any manifest that differs from what the sources give.

approvals.scope: P0 requirements of the v4 plan, verified per obligation

reconciliation: Obligations are not tasks. Each requirement is one implementation unit, linked to the work items that build it; its obligations are linked to the suites that judge them. Record-only obligations (reviews, process records, owner records, the independent verifier) need an evidence producer, not implementation. An obligation bound in several suites (for example an executable test and a review record) is judged by each and implemented once.

gateLevelScope.rule: ODR-V4-10 option A (APR-V4-OWNER-1): requirements without priority P0 stay in scope and are verified by their manifest rules and the acceptance gates (AG-11, AG-12), not per obligation. They are not excluded.

exclusions.rule: A P0 requirement leaves scope only through an exclusion whose approval is an authenticated operator change {requirement_id, action: exclude} in the pinned approvals file (v4 exclusionPolicy). None is recorded. A catalog requirement whose applicability fact is false is NOT_APPLICABLE, not excluded.
